from collections import deque

def count_returnable_rooms(n, s):
    def is_returnable(start):
        visited = set()
        stack = deque([start])
        while stack:
            current = stack.pop()
            if current in visited:
                continue
            visited.add(current)
            for i in range(n):
                if (s[i] == '>' and (current + 1) % n == i) or \
                   (s[i] == '<' and current == (i + 1) % n) or \
                   s[i] == '-':
                    stack.append(i)
        return len(visited) == n

    return sum(is_returnable(i) for i in range(n))

        stack = []

        for i in range(n):
            if not visited[i]:
                # Mark the current room as visited
                visited[i] = True
                
                # Traverse the cycle starting from the current room
                j = i
                while True:
                    if s[j % n] == '>':
                        j += 1
                    elif s[j % n] == '<':
                        j -= 1
                    else:
                        break
                    
                    # Check if we have returned to the starting room
                    if j % n == i:
                        stack.append(i)
                        break
        
        # Count the number of returnable rooms
        returnable_count = len(stack)
        results.append(returnable_count)
    
    return results

            elif s[i] == '<':

        # Count returnable rooms

    for _ in range(t):
        n = int(input())
        s = input().strip()
        
        def is_returnable(i):
            visited = set()
            stack = [(i, 0)]
            while stack:
                current, direction = stack.pop()
                if current in visited:
                    continue
                visited.add(current)
                if len(visited) == n:
                    return True
                next_room = (current + direction) % n
                if s[next_room] == '>':
                    stack.append((next_room, 1))
                elif s[next_room] == '<':
                    stack.append((next_room, -1))
                else:
                    stack.extend([(next_room, 1), (next_room, -1)])
            return False
        
        returnable_count = sum(is_returnable(i) for i in range(n))
        results.append(returnable_count)
    
    return results

        s = input().strip()
        
        # Initialize variables
        visited = [False] * n
        stack = []
        
        for i in range(n):
            if not visited[i]:
                stack.append(i)
                while stack:
                    current = stack[-1]
                    if visited[current]:
                        stack.pop()
                    else:
                        visited[current] = True
                        next_room = (current + 1) % n if s[(current + 1) % n] == '>' or s[(current + 1) % n] == '-' else (current - 1) % n
                        prev_room = (current - 1) % n if s[(current - 1) % n] == '<' or s[(current - 1) % n] == '-' else (current + 1) % n
                        if next_room != current and prev_room != current:
                            stack.append(next_room)
                            stack.append(prev_room)
                        elif next_room == current:
                            stack.append(prev_room)
                        elif prev_room == current:
                            stack.append(next_room)
        
        results.append(sum(visited))
    
    return results
